paper_title: Spectral Editing of Activations for Large Language Model Alignment
caption: : Left: Accuracy of all methods on each group of bias type in BBQ. Right: results on BBQ's testing set. All methods are applied on LLaMA-2-Chat-7B. For accuracy (A%_{}), higher values are better; for unknown-answer response rate (U%_{}), bias score (BS%_{}) and stereotypical response rate (SR%_{}), lower is better. We use bold font for the best result in each column, and mark the methods that improve ICL. : significant improvements on ICL in A% by pair-wise t-test with p < 0.05.
model_annotation: The plot displays the Mean Corpus Inference (MCI) score as a function of the number of demonstrations (#Demonstrations) for three different methods applied to the LLaMA-2-chat-7B model: Linear SAE (dark blue solid line with circular markers), LLaMA-2-chat-7B (magenta dashed line), and ICD (cyan dashed line). The x-axis is labeled “#Demonstrations” and ranges from 0 to 2000 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 500. The y-axis is labeled “MCI” and ranges from approximately 37 to 39, also on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The dark blue line (Linear SAE) starts at an MCI of approximately 37.2 at 0 demonstrations, increases to about 38.0 at 500, remains relatively flat until 1500, then rises sharply to approximately 39.0 at 2000 demonstrations. The magenta dashed line (LLaMA-2-chat-7B) remains constant at an MCI of approximately 37.2 across all demonstration counts. The cyan dashed line (ICD) is also constant at an MCI of approximately 38.0 across all demonstration counts. The cyan dashed line is labeled “ICD” and is positioned horizontally at MCI = 38.0, while the magenta dashed line is labeled “LLaMA-2-chat-7B” and is positioned at MCI = 37.2. The plot includes a title “TruthfulQA” at the top.
